bridge.en: Mei reaches the final page with a notebook beside her. Some ideas now feel clearer; one question about practical instruction is still open. She does not cross it out to make the page look finished. Finishing a reading is a useful milestone, while readiness continues through clear information, honest limits and suitable practice. This closing mission follows Mei as she chooses one small, voluntary enquiry that fits her life. There is no compulsory pledge, private contact-card upload, purchase or claim that reading completion makes someone a certified responder.
bridge.ms: Mei tiba di halaman terakhir dengan buku nota di sisinya. Beberapa idea kini lebih jelas; satu soalan tentang bimbingan amali masih terbuka. Dia tidak memadamkannya semata-mata supaya halaman kelihatan selesai. Menamatkan bacaan ialah pencapaian berguna, sementara kesediaan berterusan melalui maklumat jelas, batas jujur dan latihan sesuai. Misi penutup mengikuti Mei memilih satu pertanyaan kecil secara sukarela yang sesuai dengan kehidupannya. Tiada ikrar wajib, muat naik kad hubungan peribadi, pembelian atau dakwaan bahawa selesai membaca menjadikan seseorang petugas bertauliah.

declaration.en: I have read the notes and considered the questions and one useful next step.
declaration.ms: Saya telah membaca nota, mempertimbangkan soalan dan satu langkah seterusnya yang berguna.

rationale.en: Course completion and an observed practical assessment are different evidence.
rationale.ms: Penyelesaian kursus dan penilaian amali diperhatikan ialah bukti berbeza.

text.en: Her awareness learning is recorded; practical CPR competence has not been demonstrated.
text.ms: Pembelajaran kesedarannya direkodkan; kecekapan CPR amali belum ditunjukkan.

rationale.en: The percentage tracks topics, not compression quality or physical performance.
rationale.ms: Peratus menjejak topik, bukan kualiti tekanan atau prestasi fizikal.

text.en: The completion percentage proves she can perform CPR safely.
text.ms: Peratus selesai membuktikan dia mampu melakukan CPR dengan selamat.

rationale.en: The free learning and its completion do not require a purchase.
rationale.ms: Pembelajaran percuma dan penyelesaiannya tidak memerlukan pembelian.

text.en: She must buy the companion before any learning counts.
text.ms: Dia perlu membeli bahan rujukan sebelum pembelajaran dikira.

prompt.en: Mei completes the online missions but has not practised CPR with an instructor. Which statement is accurate?
prompt.ms: Mei menyelesaikan misi dalam talian tetapi belum berlatih CPR bersama pengajar. Pernyataan manakah tepat?

notes_prompt.en: One next learning step and a reminder I can use.
notes_prompt.ms: Satu langkah pembelajaran seterusnya dan satu peringatan yang boleh saya gunakan.

optionsMs: Mencari pilihan latihan yang boleh diakses
questions.prompt: Which next learning step feels achievable?
questions.promptMs: Langkah pembelajaran seterusnya manakah yang mampu anda laksanakan?

questions.prompt: What would help you follow through?
questions.promptMs: Apakah yang dapat membantu anda melaksanakan langkah itu hingga selesai?

options.en: A focused enquiry can clarify scope, cost, accessibility and suitable dates without committing immediately.
options.ms: Pertanyaan khusus boleh menjelaskan skop, kos, kebolehcapaian dan tarikh tanpa terus membuat komitmen.

options.en: Reviewing your unanswered questions can make a future training conversation more useful.
options.ms: Menyemak soalan belum terjawab boleh membantu perbualan latihan akan datang.

options.en: An option that fits your access needs supports meaningful participation, not a lesser form of learning.
options.ms: Pilihan sesuai dengan akses menyokong penyertaan bermakna, bukan pembelajaran yang kurang nilainya.

options.en: Use a reminder that fits an existing routine rather than creating pressure.
options.ms: Gunakan peringatan yang sesuai dengan rutin, bukan menambah tekanan.

options.en: A willing companion can help discuss questions; agree on support instead of assuming it.
options.ms: Teman yang bersedia boleh membincangkan soalan; persetujui sokongan, bukan menganggapnya.

options.en: A smaller first step can make follow-through realistic while keeping the learning purpose.
options.ms: Langkah awal lebih kecil boleh menjadikan susulan realistik sambil mengekalkan tujuan pembelajaran.

review_holds: Private candidate: Codex reference checking is not qualified clinical approval.
Conceptual diagrams only; no anatomy, infant technique, positioning or force illustration.
Clinical wording and EN/BM clinical equivalence await authorised qualified review before public release.

alt.en: Three labelled ideas: Completed reading; Practical evidence; Continuing learning.
alt.ms: Tiga idea berlabel: Bacaan selesai; Bukti amali; Pembelajaran berterusan.

caption.en: Compare these three ideas alongside the reading. This is a conceptual learning map, not a treatment diagram.
caption.ms: Bandingkan tiga idea ini bersama bacaan. Ini ialah peta konsep pembelajaran, bukan rajah rawatan.

paragraphs.en: The progress mark on Mei’s screen is satisfying. Beside it, her unanswered question still has a place. A fictional learner, Mei, reaches the last mission and can now explain why a caller should separate observation from assumption. She also knows that she has not demonstrated CPR on a manikin. Recognising both achievements and limits is a stronger foundation than treating a completed screen as proof of every first-aid skill.
paragraphs.ms: Tanda kemajuan pada skrin Mei menggembirakannya. Di sebelahnya, soalan yang belum terjawab tetap mempunyai tempat. Pelajar rekaan, Mei, tiba di misi terakhir dan boleh menjelaskan sebab pemanggil perlu membezakan pemerhatian daripada andaian. Dia juga tahu bahawa dia belum menunjukkan CPR pada manikin. Mengenali pencapaian dan batas lebih kukuh daripada menganggap skrin selesai sebagai bukti semua kemahiran pertolongan cemas.

paragraphs.en: The course’s progress percentage records completed topics. It does not measure compression quality, treatment decisions or the outcome of a future emergency. A useful personal commitment is simply to seek help clearly, act within appropriate guidance and continue learning. No signature, public pledge or promise of fearlessness is required. She can acknowledge the milestone without asking it to prove something it never measured.
paragraphs.ms: Peratus kemajuan kursus merekodkan topik selesai. Ia tidak mengukur kualiti tekanan dada, keputusan rawatan atau hasil kecemasan akan datang. Komitmen berguna ialah mendapatkan bantuan dengan jelas, bertindak mengikut panduan sesuai dan terus belajar. Tiada tandatangan, ikrar awam atau janji tidak berasa takut diperlukan. Dia boleh menghargai pencapaian itu tanpa menganggapnya bukti sesuatu yang tidak pernah diukur.

alt.en: Three labelled ideas: Confidence; Supporting evidence; Remaining question.
alt.ms: Tiga idea berlabel: Keyakinan; Bukti sokongan; Soalan yang tinggal.

caption.en: Compare these three ideas alongside the reading. This is a conceptual learning map, not a treatment diagram.
caption.ms: Bandingkan tiga idea ini bersama bacaan. Ini ialah peta konsep pembelajaran, bukan rajah rawatan.

paragraphs.en: Mei turns back to the first mission. This time, she can attach a reason to some of her confidence and a question to what remains uncertain. Revisit the six readiness areas from the opening: recognising a need for help, emergency contact knowledge, response vocabulary, AED understanding, choking awareness and practical training needs. For each, confidence and evidence can differ. Knowing where information is kept is evidence of preparation, but not evidence of a treatment skill.
paragraphs.ms: Mei kembali kepada misi pertama. Kali ini, dia dapat mengaitkan sebahagian keyakinannya dengan sebab, dan perkara yang masih tidak pasti dengan soalan. Lihat semula enam bidang awal: mengenali keperluan bantuan, mengetahui nombor kecemasan, istilah tindak balas, kefahaman AED, kesedaran tercekik dan keperluan latihan amali. Bagi setiap bidang, keyakinan dan bukti boleh berbeza. Mengetahui lokasi maklumat membuktikan persediaan, bukan kemahiran rawatan.

paragraphs.en: Mei feels more confident about explaining a location because she understood the fictional call example. She remains uncertain about practical CPR and wants instructor feedback. That combination is honest and useful. No before-and-after score needs to be submitted, and admitting uncertainty does not reduce the value of what she learned. That is a picture of learning in progress, not a reason to dismiss what has become clearer.
paragraphs.ms: Mei lebih yakin menerangkan lokasi kerana memahami contoh panggilan rekaan. Dia masih belum pasti tentang CPR amali dan mahu maklum balas pengajar. Gabungan itu jujur dan berguna. Tiada skor sebelum dan selepas perlu dihantar, dan mengakui ketidakpastian tidak mengurangkan nilai pembelajarannya. Itulah gambaran pembelajaran yang sedang berkembang, bukan alasan untuk mengetepikan perkara yang semakin jelas.

alt.en: Three labelled ideas: Useful categories; Controlled personal records; No LMS disclosure.
alt.ms: Tiga idea berlabel: Kategori berguna; Rekod peribadi terkawal; Tiada pendedahan kepada LMS.

caption.en: Compare these three ideas alongside the reading. This is a conceptual learning map, not a treatment diagram.
caption.ms: Bandingkan tiga idea ini bersama bacaan. Ini ialah peta konsep pembelajaran, bukan rajah rawatan.

title.en: Keep readiness information useful and private
title.ms: Pastikan maklumat kesediaan berguna dan peribadi

paragraphs.en: She reaches for her own notebook, then remembers the difference between a general learning reminder and a private record. A simple readiness example might include the official emergency contact, a known AED location, the person responsible for the first-aid kit and a suitable training enquiry. These categories describe useful preparation. They are not a request to collect household details, health records or contact lists inside the course platform.
paragraphs.ms: Dia mencapai buku notanya sendiri, kemudian mengingat perbezaan antara peringatan pembelajaran umum dengan rekod peribadi. Contoh kesediaan ringkas mungkin merangkumi nombor kecemasan rasmi, lokasi AED diketahui, penjaga kit pertolongan cemas dan pertanyaan latihan sesuai. Kategori ini menerangkan persediaan berguna. Ia bukan permintaan mengumpulkan butiran isi rumah, rekod kesihatan atau senarai orang untuk dihubungi dalam platform.

paragraphs.en: Actual emergency contacts, addresses, allergies or medical alerts belong in carefully managed personal records and appropriate care arrangements. Information displayed on a locked phone may be visible to people other than the owner. Consider what is necessary and who can see it; the LMS needs none of those details to record mission completion. Useful information deserves an appropriate place and appropriate access.
paragraphs.ms: Butiran untuk dihubungi semasa kecemasan, alamat, alahan atau amaran perubatan perlu disimpan dalam rekod peribadi terurus dan pengaturan penjagaan sesuai. Maklumat pada telefon terkunci mungkin dilihat orang selain pemilik. Pertimbangkan keperluan dan siapa boleh melihatnya; LMS tidak memerlukan butiran itu untuk merekodkan penyelesaian misi. Maklumat berguna wajar mempunyai tempat simpanan dan akses yang sesuai.

title.en: Keep readiness information useful and private
title.ms: Pastikan maklumat kesediaan berguna dan peribadi

alt.en: Three labelled ideas: Specific action; Realistic arrangement; Voluntary follow-through.
alt.ms: Tiga idea berlabel: Tindakan khusus; Pengaturan realistik; Tindakan susulan sukarela.

caption.en: Compare these three ideas alongside the reading. This is a conceptual learning map, not a treatment diagram.
caption.ms: Bandingkan tiga idea ini bersama bacaan. Ini ialah peta konsep pembelajaran, bukan rajah rawatan.

paragraphs.en: A long list once made Mei feel that preparation had to happen all at once. Today she chooses an enquiry she can actually describe. Instead of a long readiness promise, Mei chooses to ask a training provider about a weekend session, its language and its practice equipment. That is a specific action she can take without claiming she is already competent. Someone else may prefer to clarify an equipment location or revisit one learning question.
paragraphs.ms: Senarai panjang pernah membuat Mei berasa bahawa semua persediaan perlu dibuat serentak. Hari ini dia memilih pertanyaan yang benar-benar dapat dinyatakan. Daripada janji kesediaan panjang, Mei memilih bertanya kepada penyedia tentang sesi hujung minggu, bahasa dan peralatan latihan. Itu tindakan khusus tanpa mendakwa dirinya sudah cekap. Orang lain mungkin memilih menjelaskan lokasi peralatan atau mengulang kaji satu soalan.

paragraphs.en: A useful next step fits the person’s time, resources and accessibility needs. It can be made smaller or postponed if circumstances change. No paid companion, booking confirmation or seven-day plan is required for this free mission. If you use optional notes, copy anything worth keeping before leaving because notes are temporary. The next step can be modest and still be clear.
paragraphs.ms: Langkah berguna sesuai dengan masa, sumber dan kebolehcapaian seseorang. Ia boleh diperkecil atau ditangguhkan jika keadaan berubah. Tiada bahan berbayar, pengesahan tempahan atau pelan tujuh hari diperlukan. Jika menggunakan nota pilihan, salin perkara yang mahu disimpan sebelum keluar kerana nota bersifat sementara. Langkah seterusnya boleh kecil dan tetap jelas.

alt.en: Three labelled ideas: Clearer understanding; Practical learning still needed; Achievable support.
alt.ms: Tiga idea berlabel: Kefahaman lebih jelas; Pembelajaran amali masih perlu; Sokongan mampu dicapai.

caption.en: Compare these three ideas alongside the reading. This is a conceptual learning map, not a treatment diagram.
caption.ms: Bandingkan tiga idea ini bersama bacaan. Ini ialah peta konsep pembelajaran, bukan rajah rawatan.

paragraphs.en: Before closing the page, Mei reads her remaining question once more. It now points towards the kind of support she wants to seek. You may now explain a communication principle more clearly, recognise that an emergency description lacks information or know what to ask a qualified instructor. Those are meaningful learning outcomes. Physical competence still needs suitable practice and assessment, and a future refresher should follow the training provider’s guidance rather than an invented course promise.
paragraphs.ms: Sebelum menutup halaman, Mei membaca semula soalan yang masih ada. Soalan itu kini menunjukkan jenis sokongan yang ingin dicarinya. Anda mungkin kini lebih jelas menerangkan prinsip komunikasi, mengenali maklumat kurang dalam penerangan kecemasan atau tahu soalan untuk pengajar berkelayakan. Itu hasil pembelajaran bermakna. Kecekapan fizikal masih memerlukan amali dan penilaian sesuai; ulang kaji akan datang perlu mengikuti panduan penyedia, bukan janji kursus rekaan.

paragraphs.en: The closing reflections ask which step and support feel achievable. A reminder, a learning companion or a smaller first action can each be useful; none is a wrong personal preference. Finish with an honest sense of what became clearer and what still needs guidance, without a compulsory journal or disclosure about anyone’s health. Carry the clearer understanding with you. Let the remaining question keep its honest place.
paragraphs.ms: Refleksi penutup menanyakan langkah dan sokongan yang mampu dilakukan. Peringatan, teman belajar atau tindakan lebih kecil masing-masing berguna; tiada pilihan peribadi dianggap salah. Akhiri dengan kesedaran jujur tentang yang semakin jelas dan yang memerlukan panduan, tanpa jurnal wajib atau pendedahan kesihatan sesiapa. Bawalah kefahaman yang lebih jelas bersama anda. Biarkan soalan yang masih ada kekal di tempatnya dengan jujur.

source_map.disposition: Awareness content expanded into reading; workshop tasks adapted to fictional worked examples. Existing reflection meanings and order preserved.
Narrative teaching intent retained; no unverified true incident or compulsory physical exercise.
